# ffmpeg/ffmpeg

ffmpeg — the de-facto multimedia framework. Used by every video agent for final stitching, transcoding to platform specs, and burning captions/overlays. Invoked via shell (no MCP wrapper needed).

Caption burning (`ass`, `subtitles` filters) and text overlays (`drawtext`) need a build with libass and freetype. Debian, Ubuntu, Arch, Alpine and gyan.dev Windows builds include them. Homebrew's default `ffmpeg` formula does not, so on macOS the script installs the keg-only `ffmpeg-full` formula: it is linked onto PATH when no other ffmpeg is installed, otherwise it lives at `$(brew --prefix)/opt/ffmpeg-full/bin/ffmpeg` (the `video-captions` skill script finds it there). Check a build with `ffmpeg -hide_banner -filters | grep -wE 'ass|drawtext'`.

## Key Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:1920" out.mp4` | Resize / aspect-ratio fit |
| `ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i list.txt -c copy out.mp4` | Lossless concat |
| `ffmpeg -i v.mp4 -i a.mp3 -c:v copy -shortest out.mp4` | Overlay voiceover |
| `ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf "ass=captions.ass:fontsdir=fonts" out.mp4` | Burn styled ASS captions (libass) |
| `ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf "fps=30,scale=1080:-2" -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p out.mp4` | Re-encode for social platforms |

## Common Usage

```bash
# Concat clips for a TikTok ad (vertical 9:16, 30fps, H.264)
printf "file 'clip1.mp4'\nfile 'clip2.mp4'\nfile 'clip3.mp4'\n" > list.txt
ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i list.txt -c copy concat.mp4
ffmpeg -i concat.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1080:1920:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2" \
  -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 \
  -c:a aac -b:a 128k tiktok.mp4

# Burn word-timed ASS captions (generated by the video-captions skill script)
ffmpeg -i tiktok.mp4 -vf "ass=captions.ass:fontsdir=fonts" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy tiktok-final.mp4

# Make Homebrew's libass build the default ffmpeg on macOS (reversible)
brew unlink ffmpeg && brew link --force ffmpeg-full
# revert: brew unlink ffmpeg-full && brew link ffmpeg
```
